scenes.say: Ever wondered why vSphere features are a must-know for any virtualization role? What makes them so important?

scenes.label: vMotion
scenes.sub: Move a running VM to another host with zero downtime.
scenes.say: vMotion lets you shift a running virtual machine to another host, no downtime at all.
High Availability restarts virtual machines if a host crashes. Distributed Resource Scheduler moves VMs around to balance workloads, all while they keep running.

rows.b: Set hostname, IP, domain on clone

scenes.say: Templates act as a golden image, making new VM creation fast. Customization specs set details like hostname and network settings during cloning.

scenes.question: Does HA prevent all VM downtime?
scenes.right: No, HA restarts VMs after a host fails—there’s a short outage. Fault Tolerance keeps a live copy, with zero downtime.
scenes.say: Here’s a common interview trap: Does High Availability prevent all downtime? Actually, it just restarts VMs after a host fails, so there’s a brief outage. Fault Tolerance is what keeps things running nonstop.
